raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Depends on https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722; this branch is stacked on it.

That PR runs the MoE block's router, pooler, norm and unpooler on each rank's \(T/8\) token slice, then all-gathers the block output so the rest of the layer sees all tokens. Everything outside the block still runs replicated: the FP32 residual adds, the gated post-norms, the pre-QKV and pre-FFN norms, and the `o_proj` all-reduce.

With `--enable-expert-parallel`, EP over the whole TP group and DP1, this PR keeps the residual stream split over tokens through all layers (Megatron-style sequence parallelism) for batches of 256 or more tokens:

1. `MuseSpark1xModel.forward` takes each rank's slice of the embeddings (`sequence_parallel_chunk`).
2. Each decoder layer norms its slice, all-gathers the BF16 attention input, runs attention on all tokens, and reduce-scatters `o_proj` (built with `reduce_results=False`).
3. The post-attention norm, residual add and pre-FFN norm run on the slice. The MoE block runs its token-sharded path on the slice (`forward_local_tokens`) and skips the final all-gather.
4. The final norm runs on the slice and its output is all-gathered once.

Below 256 tokens (decode), the model takes the existing path, and attention all-reduces `o_proj` itself. The path is off for DSpark draft layers, under PP, and when aux hidden states are requested (EAGLE-style drafters).

## Claims

- Serving PTPC-FP8, TP8 + EP on 8× MI300X, on top of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722: +2.5–3.6% total throughput at 8k input and +4.9–6.4% at 16k input for concurrency 16–64 (1k output), and +0.3–2.5% at lower concurrency. Median TTFT is 9–10% lower at every 8k and 16k point except 16k c32 (2.66 → 2.88 s). At 1k input the change is within ±2%. Together with that PR: +12.5% at 8k c64 and +18.7% at 16k c64 over the unpatched nightly.
- GSM8K 5-shot is unchanged within error: 95.00% vs 95.38% flexible-extract with https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722 alone (±0.6%).
- MXFP4 on 4× MI355X (gfx950), TP4 + EP, real weights, on top of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722: +4.5–5.8% total throughput at 8k input and +5.9–8.6% at 16k input for concurrency 16–64. Against the unpatched nightly the stack gives +3.3–4.8% at 8k and +4.4–6.7% at 16k for the same points, with median TTFT about 10% lower. GSM8K is unchanged within error (94.54% vs 94.92%, ±0.6%).

## Validation

**Unit tests.** `tests/models/test_muse_spark_token_sharded.py` (2 GPUs) builds two production `MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer`s at TP2 + EP, with attention replaced by a token-mixing stub that keeps the real `o_proj` and its reduce-scatter, and checks the token-sharded residual stream against the full-token path on the same weights at 301 and 512 tokens. The outputs are bit-identical at TP2; a variant that skips the `o_proj` reduction fails (47% of elements off). With the MoE block test from https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722 and `tests/kernels/moe/test_muse_spark_rocm_bf16_moe.py`: 34 passed, 3 skipped on MI300X (`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-5d35ce3934` with this branch's files mounted). The test runs in the "(MI300) Distributed Models" CI step added by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722.

**Serving, MI300X.** `amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-PTPC-FP8`, TP8 + `--enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend triton`, 8× MI300X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-83c078d955` with the files of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63722 or of this branch mounted, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-num-seqs 128 --no-enable-prefix-caching`. `vllm bench serve` random dataset, `--random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos`, seed 6, 3 × concurrency prompts per point (4 at c1), one run per point.

+NUM_LAYERS = 2

+class _TokenMixingAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Mixes all tokens like attention does, without a KV cache."""

+    def __init__(self, *args, prefix: str = "", **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_name = prefix
+
+    def forward(self, q, k, v):
+        return q + q.float().mean(0).to(q.dtype)
+
+
+def _make_config() -> VllmConfig:
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        parallel_config=ParallelConfig(
+            tensor_parallel_size=2,
+            enable_expert_parallel=True,
+            all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",

+def _make_moe(config: VllmConfig, rank: int) -> nn.Module:
+    """A production MoE block with identical weights plus distinct expert shards."""
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        block = muse_model.MuseSpark1xMoE(
+            config, layer_idx=0, prefix="model.layers.0.feed_forward"

+    torch.manual_seed(7)

+def _check_moe_block(rank: int, config: VllmConfig) -> None:

+    # Token counts with and without padding to the TP size.
+    for num_tokens in (301, 512):
+        torch.manual_seed(num_tokens)
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE)
+        with (
+            set_current_vllm_config(config),
+            set_forward_context(None, config, num_tokens=num_tokens),

+                expected = block(x).clone()

+
+
+def _make_layers(config: VllmConfig, rank: int) -> nn.ModuleList:
+    """Production layers with identical weights plus distinct rank shards."""
+    with (
+        set_current_vllm_config(config),
+        patch.object(muse_model, "Attention", _TokenMixingAttention),
+        patch.object(muse_model, "supports_fused_kv_insert", lambda attn: False),

+    return layers
+
+
+def _run_layers(layers, positions, x, token_sharded: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+    num_tokens = positions.shape[0]
+    if token_sharded:
+        x = sequence_parallel_chunk(x)

+        x = layer(positions, x, token_sharded)

+    if token_sharded:
+        out = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(out.contiguous(), 0)[:num_tokens]
+    return out.clone()
+
+
+def _check_token_sharded(rank: int, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    layers = _make_layers(config, rank)
+    # Token counts with and without padding to the TP size.
+    for num_tokens in (301, 512):
+        torch.manual_seed(num_tokens)
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE, dtype=torch.float32)
+        positions = torch.arange(num_tokens)
+        with (
+            set_current_vllm_config(config),
+            set_forward_context(None, config, num_tokens=num_tokens),
+        ):
+            expected = _run_layers(layers, positions, x, token_sharded=False)
+            actual = _run_layers(layers, positions, x, token_sharded=True)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=0.002, rtol=0.02)
+
+
+def _run(rank: int, port: int, check) -> None:
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    config = _make_config()
+    init_distributed_environment(
+        world_size=2,
+        rank=rank,
+        local_rank=rank,
+        distributed_init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}",
+    )
+    try:
+        init_workspace_manager(torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}"))
+        with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+            initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=2)
+            with torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}"), torch.inference_mode():
+                torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
+                check(rank, config)
+    finally:
+        reset_workspace_manager()
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=2)
+def test_token_sharded_moe_block_matches_all_reduce() -> None:
+    """The token-sharded MoE block matches its all-reduce path."""
+    mp.spawn(_run, args=(get_open_port(), _check_moe_block), nprocs=2)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=2)
+def test_token_sharded_decoder_layers_match_full_tokens() -> None:
+    """The sharded residual stream and MoE block match the replicated path."""
+    mp.spawn(_run, args=(get_open_port(), _check_token_sharded), nprocs=2)
